{{quote|Now. When the poor blind fool they’ve chosen out for their Amyrlin gets here, I will do the talking. She can’t be very bright, or they’d never have been able to shove her into the job. Amyrlin Seat for a bloody village in the middle of bloody nowhere. You keep your mouths shut and curtsy for all you’re worth, and I’ll pull your bacon off the coals again.|[[Matrim Cauthon]] to [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]}}
